intro: Sierra Leone is rich in minerals such as diamonds, iron ore and rutile.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Diamonds, iron ore, rutile and bauxite are mined. Most people farm rice and cassava, and fishing is important.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Beaches near Freetown are slowly attracting tourists again.

keyTerms.meaning: A mineral used to make titanium.

cardGroups.title: Made in Sierra Leone
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Sierra Leone makes and sells to the world.
